lines.trans: Senya, what on earth is that you have?
You must not drag good groceries home.
Chef, honestly I did not steal anything.
Keep in mind, I know all your hiding places well.
So do not even try to argue.
Done, I cleaned all the contacts here.
Wow, what an electrician you are!
Never hold onto an electrician with your hands.
Let us go to the kitchen, we still have to cook.
Max, get me the rice from the top shelf.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and, but', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Наш ресторан всегда остаётся лучшим в Москве.

examples.text: У нас работает команда профессиональных поваров.

examples.text: Здесь всегда продукты самого высокого качества.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'чему').

examples.text: А почему я должен прийти с Катей?
examples.trans: And why should I come with Katya?

examples.text: Нет, расскажи, почему ты спрашиваешь?

examples.text: А почему именно ты это должен делать?
examples.trans: And why do you have to be the one to do that?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'разу').

examples.text: А почему сразу именно я должен доставать?
examples.trans: And why do I have to be the one to get it?

examples.text: Решив одни проблемы, мы встречаем сразу новые.
examples.trans: Having solved some problems, we immediately meet new ones.

examples.text: Сразу видно.
examples.trans: You can see it at once.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'specifically', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вот именно.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must').

доставать.gloss: to reach; to take out, to get

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'ставать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to reach; to take out, to get', paired with 'достать'.

examples.text: А почему сразу именно я должен доставать?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'over there', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вон рядом стоит высокий Лёва, попроси его.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'beside', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Настоящий ресторан делает хорошую еду.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'сокий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('high').
